title: Command-Space Counterfactual Explanations for Pareto-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pareto Conditioned Networks learn multiple multi-objective reinforcement learning behaviours by conditioning a single policy on a desired return command. However, the local mapping from command and state to action remains opaque. We propose command-space counterfactual explanations for PCNs: given a fixed state, original command, and foil action, we search, in a black-box setting, for a minimally changed desired-return command under which the same trained policy would choose the foil. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate PCN explanations as return-command interventions, using a return-only PCN variant that avoids the added ambiguity of horizon-conditioning. Second, we adapt adversarial machine learning methods to reinforcement-learning explanations. Third, we introduce a boundary-seeded directional search that improves over purely local optimization in the command-action landscape, resulting in our proposed approach CF-

translated_title: 帕累托条件强化学习的命令空间反事实解释
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14963v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：帕累托条件网络通过将单一策略条件化于期望回报命令，学习多种多目标强化学习行为。然而，从命令和状态到动作的局部映射仍然不透明。我们提出针对PCN的命令空间反事实解释：给定固定状态、原始命令和对抗动作，我们在黑盒设置中搜索一个最小改变的期望回报命令，在该命令下，同一训练策略会选择该对抗动作。我们的贡献有三方面。首先，我们将PCN解释形式化为回报命令干预，使用仅回报的PCN变体，以避免水平条件带来的额外模糊性。其次，我们将对抗机器学习方法适应于强化学习解释。第三，我们引入一种边界种子定向搜索，在命令-动作景观中优于纯局部优化，从而提出我们的方法CF-。
tldr: 本文提出一种针对帕累托条件网络的黑盒反事实解释方法，通过边界种子定向搜索找到最小改变的回报命令，以解释策略在给定状态下为何选择特定动作，并改进了局部优化效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a black-box counterfactual explanation method for Pareto-Conditioned Networks, using boundary-seeded directional search to find minimally changed return commands that explain policy actions in given states, improving over local optimization.
